results.title: Scanpy
results.description: Scanpy is a scalable toolkit for analyzing single-cell gene expression data with preprocessing, visualization, clustering, trajectory inference, and differential expression testing capabilities.

results.title: Scapy
results.description: Scapy is a powerful Python-based interactive packet manipulation program and library for forging, decoding, and sending network packets with support for a wide variety of protocols.

results.title: Infercnvpy
results.description: Infercnvpy is a scalable Python library and Scanpy plugin to infer copy number variation (CNV) events from single-cell transcriptomics data.

results.title: ScanPilot
results.description: ScanPilot là một nền tảng quản lý các công cụ quét bảo mật với giao diện web hiện đại, cho phép quản lý targets, domains, subdomains và thực hiện các scan với real-time monitoring.

results.title: Python-pptx
results.description: Create Open XML PowerPoint documents in Python

results.title: scany
results.description: scany is a Go library that allows developers to scan complex data from a database into Go structs and other composite types with just one function call.

results.title: Scanopy
results.description: Network discovery and visualization tool that automatically discovers hosts, services, and network topology across your infrastructure.

results.title: Muon
results.description: Muon is a multimodal omics Python framework designed around MuData objects for integrating and analyzing various biological data types, extending scanpy's functionality.

results.title: EpiScanpy
results.description: EpiScanpy is a toolkit for analyzing single-cell open chromatin and DNA methylation data, serving as the epigenomic extension of the popular Scanpy scRNA-seq analysis tool.

results.title: Scirpy
results.description: Scirpy is a Python package for analyzing T cell receptor and B cell receptor repertoires from single-cell RNA sequencing data, seamlessly integrated with scanpy and mudata.

results.title: diffxpy
results.description: diffxpy is a Python library for fast and scalable differential expression analysis on single-cell RNA-seq data, integrated with scanpy workflows.

results.title: Drug2cell
results.description: Gene group activity utility functions for scanpy, including per-cell scoring and enrichment/overrepresentation analyses with pre-built ChEMBL drug target sets.

results.title: Scanopy
results.description: Scanopy scans networks to identify hosts and services, generating interactive visualizations for clean network diagrams and automated documentation with zero upkeep.

results.title: Sanpy
results.description: Sanpy is a Python client library for the Santiment API that provides access to on-chain, social, development, and price metrics for thousands of cryptocurrency assets, returning results as pandas DataFrames with datetime indexing.

results.title: Rapids Singlecell
results.description: Rapids Singlecell provides GPU-accelerated single-cell analysis with an AnnData-first API, compatible with Scanpy and including functionality from Squidpy and decoupler, using CuPy and NVIDIA RAPIDS for performance on large datasets.

results.title: pychromVAR
results.description: pychromVAR is a Python package for inferring transcription factor binding variability from single-cell ATAC-seq (scATAC-seq) data by implementing the chromVAR algorithm, seamlessly integrating with Scanpy and Muon pipelines.

results.title: BBKNN
results.description: BBKNN is a fast and intuitive batch effect removal tool that can be directly used in the scanpy workflow, serving as an alternative to scanpy.pp.neighbors() for creating a neighbour graph.

results.title: CyteType
results.description: CyteType performs automated, evidence-based cell type annotation for single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data using a multi-agent AI architecture, integrating with Scanpy and Seurat workflows.

results.title: Scandit
results.description: Scandit is a Smart Data Capture platform that empowers frontline workers with the flexible, modern way to capture barcodes, text, objects, and IDs.

results.title: SeuratDisk
results.description: SeuratDisk provides an R interface for the h5Seurat file format, designed for storing multi-modal single-cell and spatially-resolved expression experiments, and enables rapid conversion between h5Seurat and AnnData objects to enhance interoperability between Seurat and Scanpy.

results.title: Scaniverse
results.description: Scaniverse helps teams capture spaces with mobile and 360 cameras, generate Gaussian splats and meshes, and prepare sites for reliable localization.

results.title: Scanify
results.description: Scanify is an API that extracts and validates data from Brazilian documents like invoices and boletos, providing structured and validated data from PDFs or images for automation and system integration.

results.title: ScandiPWA
results.description: A next-generation Magento 2 front-end written in React with improved performance, Progressive Web Application capabilities, and flexible customization technologies.

results.title: ScandiPWA User Manual
results.description: User manual documentation for ScandiPWA, a progressive web app implementation for Magento 2 e-commerce platforms, covering configuration, catalog management, marketing, sales, and customer features.

results.title: Holographic Material for React Three Fiber
results.description: A simple-to-use React component that provides a mesmerizing holographic material for Three.js, bringing virtual reality experiences to life with vibrant colors, dynamic scanlines, and customizable effects.

results.title: Scandit Smart Data Capture
results.description: Scandit Smart Data Capture enables mobile devices to capture and process barcodes and other data using computer vision and machine learning, offering customizable APIs and pre-built UI components for various scanning needs.

results.title: OpenVectorFormat
results.description: OpenVectorFormat is an open, feature-rich protobuf-based format for scanner-based laser manufacturing that supports multi-scanfield arrays, machine axis controls, and comprehensive metadata for process monitoring and quality assurance.

results.title: ScandiPWA
results.description: A next-generation PWA front-end for Magento 2 with middleware-less architecture, supporting 350+ Magento features with fast performance and extensible design.

results.title: Collatinus
results.description: Collatinus is a free, open-source Latin lemmatizer, morphological analyzer, and metrical scansion tool for analyzing Latin texts.

results.title: Tegel Design System
results.description: The Tegel Design System supports the design and development of digital solutions at Scania, ensuring a coherent, premium brand and user experience across all digital touchpoints.
